mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation and compress corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive up costs and compress corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth drops by > 3pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts, as measured by the year-over-year change in the housing starts index, signals a weakening economy that will reduce consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y HOUST growth drops by > 10% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate, as measured by the 3-month change in the effective federal funds rate, signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive up borrowing costs and compress corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in FEDFUNDS > 0.5pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating increase in payroll employment, as measured by the 3-month change in the total nonfarm payroll employment index, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-month change in PAYEMS > 1% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the consumer price index, as measured by the year-over-year change in the CPI index, signals rising inflationary pressures that will erode consumer purchasing power and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y CPIAUCSL inflation > 3% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in > 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in real estate investment, as measured by the year-over-year change in the real estate investment component of GDP, signals a weakening economy that will reduce construction activity and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth drops by > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances.
